> **Entity**: Tamil Sangam at The Ohio State University (Registered Student Organization)
> **Tamil Name**: ஒஹையோ மாநிலப் பல்கலைக்கழகத் தமிழ்ச் சங்கம்
> **Alternate Names**: OSU Tamil Sangam, Ohio State Tamil Sangam, Tamil Sangam OSU, Tamil Student Association at Ohio State, Columbus Tamil Students, Buckeye Tamil
> **Parent Institution**: The Ohio State University (https://www.osu.edu, Columbus, Ohio)

> **Email**: osutamilsangam@gmail.com

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Mission
OSU Tamil Sangam is the official, student-led cultural and social student organization serving undergraduate and graduate students, scholars, postdocs, alumni, and friends across The Ohio State University and greater Columbus, Ohio.

Founded informally in 2021 and officially registered with Ohio State Student Activities in 2024, Tamil Sangam exists to foster a warm, inclusive, and culturally vibrant community on campus. We celebrate millennia of Tamil heritage, literature, music, dance, and cuisine while creating a welcoming home-away-from-home along the Olentangy River.

---

## 2. Core Policies & Values

### 100% Free Membership & Zero Dues
- Membership is completely free for all Ohio State students.
- There are no dues, fees, or attendance minimums.
- To join, students can visit the website (/join) or join the student GroupMe chat.

### No Language Requirement
- You do NOT need to speak or understand Tamil to join OSU Tamil Sangam.
- All announcements, meetings, and major programs are conducted bilingually or in English.
- Students of all racial, cultural, linguistic, and academic backgrounds are enthusiastically welcomed.

### Philosophical Anchor: Classical Sangam Epics
- **Purananuru 192** (Kaniyan Poongundranar): *"யாதும் ஊரே யாவரும் கேளிர்"* ("To us all towns are home, and everyone our kin"). Our community practices unconditional fellowship and global hospitality.
- **Thirukkural 81** (Thiruvalluvar): *"இருந்தோம்பி இல்வாழ்வ தெல்லாம் விருந்தோம்பி வேளாண்மை செய்தற் பொருட்டு"* ("The purpose of establishing a hearth is to welcome guests with warmth and generosity"). Shared food and open hospitality anchor every meeting.

---

## 3. The Five Pillars of Sangam (ஐந்து தூண்கள்)
1. **ஆட்டம் (Aatam — Dance & Movement)**: Classical Bharatanatyam, contemporary Kollywood choreography, Kuthu & Gaana energetic dance circles, and open campus workshops.
2. **பாட்டம் (Paatam — Music & Harmony)**: Carnatic recitals, acoustic jam sessions, Parai Attam traditional drumming, and collegiate Kollywood sing-alongs.
3. **கொண்டாட்டம் (Kondatam — Festivities & Celebrations)**: Annual flagship campus celebrations including Diwali, Pongal harvest banquets, and Spring Carnivals.
4. **சந்திப்பும் (Santhippum — Fellowship & Socials)**: South Oval lawn picnics, board game nights, chai meetups, and late-night study sessions at Thompson Library and 18th Avenue Library.
5. **கற்றல் (Katral — Learning & Heritage)**: Conversational Tamil workshops, script reading sessions, and open discussions on Sangam poetry and modern literature.

---

## 4. Key Annual Events & Gatherings

### 1. Namma Deepavali (TS × MS × KS)
- **Partners**: Joint celebration hosted with Mallu Society (MS) and Kannada Sangam (KS) at Ohio State.
- **Location**: Ohio Union Ballrooms / Campus Venues, Columbus, OH.
- **Features**: Traditional attire, multi-course South Indian dinner, live music acts, high-energy dance performances, and social fellowship.
- **Admission**: Free / Subsidized for all Ohio State students.

### 2. Pongal Harvest Festival & Feast (பொங்கல் திருநாள்)
- **Features**: Traditional sweet Pongal cooked fresh, banana leaf banquet, folk dance, Kolam competitions, and cultural games celebrating the Tamil harvest.
- **Location**: Ohio Union / Campus Spaces.

### 3. Yaar Andha Killer? (ஹாலோவீன் மர்ம இரவு)
- **Theme**: Halloween murder mystery whodunnit night set in a Tamil cinematic universe.
- **Features**: Interactive clue puzzles, catered Indian dinner, character costumes, and awards.

### 4. A Berry Cute Picnic (இலையுதிர் சங்கமம்)
- **Location**: South Oval Lawn, The Ohio State University.
- **Features**: Fall semester welcome picnic with blankets, card games, fresh fruit, Uno tournaments, and campus networking.

### 5. Streetside Sapad Night (தெருவோரச் சாப்பாடு)
- **Theme**: General Body Meeting celebrating roadside delicacies of Chennai and Madurai.
- **Features**: Samosas, biryani, street-style snacks, Kahoot trivia, and team games.

### 6. Namma Jathara Carnival (நம்ம ஜாதரா)
- **Partners**: Joint celebration co-hosted with Telugu Tamasha at OSU.
- **Location**: RPAC Plaza and South Oval, Columbus, OH.

## 6. Student Guide to Columbus & Ohio State

### Campus Transit
- **CABS (Campus Area Bus Service)**: Free for all students with BuckID. West Campus route connects Carmack lots to RPAC and Ohio Union.
- **COTA Buses**: Line 1 & 2 run down High Street directly from campus to Downtown Columbus, Short North, and Clintonville.

### South Asian Groceries in Columbus
- **Saraga International Grocery**: 1265 Morse Rd, Columbus, OH 43229 (Massive selection of Indian spices, fresh curry leaves, dosa batter, snacks).
- **Patel Brothers**: 2610 Sawmill Place Blvd, Columbus, OH 43235.
- **Bhavani Cash & Carry**: 2853 Festival Ln, Dublin, OH 43017.

### South Indian Restaurants in Columbus
- **Bawarchi Biryanis**: 7765 Sawmill Rd, Dublin, OH 43016 (Biryani, curries, South Indian specialties).
- **Aachi Aappakadai**: 7370 Sawmill Rd, Columbus, OH 43235 (Chettinad curries, parotta, aappam).
- **Dosa Corner**: 1070 Old Henderson Rd, Columbus, OH 43220 (Traditional dosas, idli, sambar).
- **Gokul Cafe**: 2685 E Main St, Bexley, OH 43209 (Vegetarian chaat, dosas, thali).

---

## 7. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Q: Who can join OSU Tamil Sangam?
**A**: Any student, researcher, scholar, or faculty member at The Ohio State University is eligible to join. We are open to undergraduates, graduate students, and Columbus community allies.

### Q: Do I need to pay membership fees?
**A**: No. Membership in OSU Tamil Sangam is 100% free with zero dues. We believe cultural connection should be accessible to all.

### Q: What if I do not speak Tamil?
**A**: You are completely welcome! A significant portion of our members are learning Tamil, are second-generation diaspora, or are non-Tamil students interested in Indian culture and good food. All official club communication and meetings are conducted in English.

### Q: How do I become an active member?
**A**: Join our student GroupMe (link in our bio or on the website), follow our Instagram (@tamilsangam.osu), and attend any of our gatherings. You can also sign the Guestbook at https://tamil-sangam-website-osu.vercel.app/join.

### Q: What is the Sangam Arcade?
**A**: The Sangam Arcade (https://tamil-sangam-website-osu.vercel.app/games) is our interactive web hub featuring monthly bilingual word puzzles: Sollu (a Tamil/Tanglish Wordle game) and Thodarpu (a Tamil Connections category game).

### Q: Where do meetings take place?
**A**: Meetings are primarily held at the Ohio Union (1739 N High St, Columbus, OH 43210), with outdoor gatherings on the South Oval Lawn and cultural performances in campus auditoriums.
